command.mdt.toggle.description.chatMaxLe:
Control the behavior about chat max length. 
 - unlimited: Unlimited chat input. However, because the game network doesn't support chats longer than 256 characters, the server will kick you as invalid packets. 
 - limited: Chat length is limited to 256 characters (vanilla behavior). 
 - restrictedAfterSending: Chat field length is unlimited, but in order to avoid being kicked, the chat will be truncated to 256 characters. This is made for client-side commands, as they may support long commands. 
 - sendByParts: Chat field length is unlimited, but in order to avoid being kicked, the chat will be splitted into parts of length specified in sendByPartsPartSize. The time interval between each part is specified in sendByPartsIntervalMillis. This is made for client-side commands, as they may support long commands.
command.mdt.toggle.description.disableBl: If true, the blindness effect will not influence the player's vision or prevent the player from sprinting. If false, the blindness effect works as vanilla behavior.
command.mdt.toggle.description.disableDa: If true, the darkness effect will not influence the player's vision. If false, the darkness effect works as vanilla behavior.
command.mdt.toggle.description.disableRe: If true, the buttons in death screens will be enabled immediately after the player has died. If false, the buttons will be disabled in the first one second after the player has died as vanilla behavior.
command.mdt.toggle.description.chatOnDea: If true, there will be a button to open chat when the player dies.
command.mdt.toggle.description.disableNi: If true, the night vision effect will not influence rendering. If false, the night vision effect works as vanilla behavior.
command.mdt.toggle.description.showBarri: If true, there will be a model visible in any game mode for barriers. Reloading chunks may be needed to update models.
command.mdt.toggle.description.sysio.sen: If true, the messages in System.out print stream will be sent to the chat.
If true, the messages in System.err print stream will be sent to the chat in red font.
command.mdt.toggle.description.playerAle: If true, there will be a notice message when a player is in the specified area.
The radius of the alert area. Must be ≥0.
If true, you will also trigger the player alert.
If true, there will be a notice sound for the player alert.
command.mdt.toggle.description.sendByPar: The size of each part of the chat message for sendByParts. Must be ≥1. Can be >256, but will be kicked as invalid packets.
The time interval (in milliseconds) between each part of the chat message. Must be ≥0.
